registryBasis: The official Banda district administration land-records page identifies the UP Bhulekh service as implemented in all tehsils and places the Bhulekh office at tehsil level in Banda. The UP GeoDashboard reports Banda district cadastral-map digitization and georeferencing counts. This evidences a local/district land-record custodian and cadastral program, not an open parcel geometry API.

requests.outcome: Official Banda district page fetched; confirms UP Bhulekh land-record service, tehsil-level office scope, and district administration ownership. No parcel geometry or feature schema present.

Official dashboard fetched; Banda district rows show cadastral maps linked to Bhunaksha and georeferencing progress, including the Banda tehsil row. Dashboard is aggregate evidence only and returned no parcel IDs or polygons.
